judgments.reason: The passage and Figure 3 caption state that the trained network is used to generate steering commands from a single front-facing center camera.
The passage explicitly says that training data was collected by driving on a wide variety of roads and in a diverse set of lighting and weather conditions.
The passage states that most road data was collected in central New Jersey, and highway data was also collected from Illinois, Michigan, Pennsylvania, and New York.
The passage lists other road types as including two-lane roads (with and without lane markings), residential roads with parked cars, tunnels, and unpaved roads.
The passage says data was collected in clear, cloudy, foggy, snowy, and rainy weather, both day and night.
The passage states that in some instances, the sun was low in the sky, resulting in glare reflecting from the road surface and scattering from the windshield.
The passage says data was acquired using either a 2016 Lincoln MKZ or a 2013 Ford Focus with cameras placed in similar positions to those in the Lincoln.
The passage explicitly states that the system has no dependencies on any particular vehicle make or model.
The passage says drivers were encouraged to maintain full attentiveness, but otherwise drive as they usually do.
